## Plan

- New module `crates/hh-analysis/src/receipt.rs` — the producer-side
  all-planned receipt (records-in like R5.15b's `population.rs`
  adapter; the "analysis/report owner" the contract names; every owner
  type reachable — no new crate edge):
  - **Expected side** derived from pinned owner views: `ExperimentView`
    plans/attempts/launch_binding (slots→plans→first/all attempts),
    `EvalRun` projections (outcome/disposition/veto/settlement state),
    the R5.15 `eval::population::assemble` contract for member
    resolution + the three named populations (X7).
  - **Declared side** — the records the receipt asserts (records-in):
    frozen slot set, per-plan attempt sets, per-attempt
    settlement/cost records `{run, settlement_ref, cost_version}`,
    grade records `{run, grade_ref, selection_ref, ordinal,
    counts_subject, status}`, row records `{run, version_id,
    plan_ref}`, and the analysis declaration `{protocol_ref,
    prices{price_table_version, confidence}, method{estimator,
    version}, seed, draws, weights}` — bound exactly, never implied.
  - **Six reconcile legs** (each reports expected/joined/failures):
    slots→plans (dropped/extra member fails — not-run/refused/pending
    are still required members), plans→attempts (orphan launch +
    dropped/extra attempt fails), attempts→settlements (settled
    attempt without a cost record, duplicate, stale `cost_version`,
    or settlement on an unbound run fails), attempts→selected grades
    (duplicate `counts_subject`/grade_ref, stale `selection_ref`,
    skipped/format-failure presented as selected, unbound join all
    fail; a grade retry never counts subject n — I-03),
    attempts→rows (settled subject without a row, duplicate, wrong
    plan join, unbound run fails; a bound-not-run subject is a typed
    `not_run` loss, never a pass), rows→analysis (absent required
    pin fails — protocol/prices/method/seed/draws/weights are
    republished verbatim).
  - **Per-slot four-axis verdicts** (§6.1): prerequisite
    {available, unavailable, unknown}, process/invocation
    {not_run, started, finished, unknown}, task
    {pass, fail, refused, unsupported, skipped, unknown}, veto
    {none, observed(+ids), unknown} — process success never erases a
    skipped/format failure and never promotes an evidence class.
  - `population-receipt/1` canonical JSON record: `{schema, version,
    pins{…}, legs[], slots[], attempts[], populations, verdict,
    failures[]}` — a derived index, never a second store; verdict
    `closed | failed`; reconcile mismatches are recorded findings,
    contract refusals (PopulationError) propagate verbatim.
- `lib.rs`: `pub mod receipt` + re-exports.
- `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_23.rs`: AC-1/AC-2 battery.
- Records: ADR (implementation landing record) if an owned decision
  lands, coverage dated contributing note (AC-3), pr/R5.23.md.

## Test matrix (from ACs — written before implementation)

- T1 full_chain_reconciles_closed (AC-1): multi-plan view with
  scored/failed/unrun slots, retries, settlements + grades + rows +
  analysis decl → verdict `closed`; legs carry expected/joined sets;
  pins bound verbatim; four-axis verdicts per slot.
- T2 dropped_unrun_slot_fails (AC-2): declared slot set drops a
  planned-but-unrun slot → `dropped_slot` failure (retrospective
  shrink refused); extra slot → `extra_slot`.
- T3 orphan_launch_fails (AC-2): settlement/grade/row on a run bound
  to no plan → `orphan_launch`.
- T4 duplicate_grade_fails (AC-2): two `counts_subject` grades on one
  attempt / repeated grade_ref → `duplicate_grade`; a retry's
  `counts_subject` → `grade_retry_adds_n` (I-03).
- T5 skipped_or_format_failure_cannot_pass (AC-2): a grade whose
  status is `skipped`/`format_failure` presented as `selected` or
  `counts_subject` → failure; the task axis reads skipped/unknown —
  a finished process axis does not promote it.
- T6 stale_versions_fail (AC-2): settlement `cost_version` ≠ pinned
  cost version → `stale_cost_version`; grade `selection_ref` ≠ the
  pinned selection → `stale_selection`.
- T7 wrong_member_join_fails (AC-2): a row/grade whose declared
  plan_ref differs from the run's bound plan → `wrong_member_join`;
  settled subject without a row → `missing_row`.
- T8 pending_and_notrun_verdicts (AC-1): grade_pending slot → pending
  member + unresolved, never a pass; bound-not-run subject → typed
  `not_run` row loss; veto axis stays separate from class.
- T9 extras_make_no_decision (AC-2): extra declared settlement/row/
  grade naming unbound ids fails as orphan; receipt carries no
  evidence-class promotion (schema/verdict fields only — class is
  fixed `engineered-derived`, a hash match or finished invocation
  never raises it).

## Cap trigger — STOPPED for a scoped ruling (CAP DISCIPLINE)

The complete AC-1+AC-2 implementation measures **1,527 changed
source/test lines** vs the contract's **≤950 split trigger** (~1.6×):

| file | lines |
|---|---|
| `crates/hh-analysis/src/receipt.rs` (new) | +1,065 |
| `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_23.rs` (new) | +456 |
| `crates/hh-analysis/src/lib.rs` | +6 |

(`git diff --cached --numstat -- '*.rs'` at the checkpoint commit —
code+test only; docs/records excluded.)

The weight is the admitted reconcile, not padding: §6.1 names the
six-hop set-equality chain (slots→plans→first/all
attempts→settlements/selected grades→rows→analysis) plus the four
separate verdict axes (prerequisite/invocation/task/veto incl. the
six-value semantic set), the closed fourteen-code failure set, the
records-in declared side (settlement/grade/row/analysis declarations
with stale-version pins), the typed refusal semantics that retain
orphans/deviations as findings rather than thrown errors, the
`population-receipt/1` canonical codec, and a nine-case battery
covering every AC-2 negative. No AC was dropped.

**Seam analysis.** Candidate cuts: (a) record/types/codec vs
reconcile legs — rejected: the record is the legs' own fold; a
types-only leg cannot execute either AC. (b) chain legs vs the
per-slot verdict block — rejected: AC-1 binds the axes *to* the
chain members; a legs-only receipt drops the named axes, a
verdicts-only receipt has no chain to join. (c) contract-in-eval vs
adapter (the landed R5.15/R5.15b seam) — rejected: the receipt's
joins bind `ExperimentView`/`EvalRun`/grade-selection and results-row
records hh-eval cannot name without a reverse edge; the shared
population contract already landed and is consumed unchanged (X7).
The decomposition names ONE owner for this slice — row 31 "R5.23
assembly", anchored on the analysis/report owner — and Packet C C.1
item 6 forbids the crate edge a contract-layer cut would need. Same
objection shape the R5.19–R5.22 scoped reviews found.

**Magnitude:** ~1.6× is inside the accepted band (≤2.6× R5.8;
~1.9–2.4× routinely amended incl. R5.21 at ~2.4×, R5.22 at ~2.0×).

**Proposed disposition:** AMEND — land the module + battery as one
unit; the implementation is complete and green (hh-analysis 90/0
incl. r5_23 9/9; fmt + clippy clean; fails-without compile-red at
base `d5f6810a` — `hharness_analysis::receipt` does not exist
there), checkpointed below for review. If SPLIT is preferred, the
weakest documented cut is (a) `receipt.rs` legs 1–5 + declared
records → (b) leg 6 + per-slot verdicts + codec + battery — leg (a)
remains over trigger alone.
